title: 第5章 高冷女上司第6章 第一个任务
content_zh:
宋明远笑了笑：“其实不良人真正考核只有前面两关，至于第三关，其实是选人。”
“咱们江州城的不良人府衙内，有统领一位，副统领五位，银牌二十二位，铜牌两百零六人，不算主簿，典吏之类的文职。”
“每位副统领手下可统银牌四人，每位银牌手下可领铜牌三到五人，这第三关，就是看看有没有哪位银牌或者副统领愿意接纳你。”
“当然，最终决定权还是在副统领手上，就比如说我，我也可以要你，但我需要跟我的上司打报告，她同意了我才能要你。”
姜峰想了想，问道：“那，如果没人选我呢？”
宋明远摊了摊手：“那你就只能成为散人，散人一般有两种去处，能识文断字的，就充当府衙的典吏。
只会武艺的，就负责巡逻，站岗。
若有哪个队伍查案缺乏人手，就去哪个队伍里帮忙。”
姜峰恍然大悟，也就是说，从他通过文考的那一刻开始，他就可以算是一个不良人了。
只是还未能确定是否能编入一支作战队伍里面。
宋明远意味深长的看着姜峰：“你有介绍信，想来不会出现那种情况。”
每年都有人通过关系进入不良人。
这种走后门进来的人，只要武道境界达标，基本就没有入不了不良人的。
什么，你说不是还有文考吗？
呵，走后门的人，会不知道文考的内容和答案吗？
这种事情其实大家都心知肚明。
而且能够走后门进来的人，多半都是有背景，有靠山的人。
他们就算看不起对方，明面上也不会表露出来。
官场上除了尔虞我诈，还有人情世故。
因此，在宋明远看来，姜峰这种走后门进来的人，最起码有人兜底，不至于无人选择，成为散人。

姜峰自然是听出了宋明远的弦外之意，只是略微皱了皱眉，并没有多说什么。
他只是请老师给自己写一封介绍信，至于信上说了什么，他也不知晓。
实际上，老师此前一直不支持自己进入不良人，在读书人眼中，走科举晋升之路才是正道。
姜峰为此也是磨破了嘴皮子，最终才说服了老师写这封信。
很快。
宋明远带着姜峰来到后院的练武场，这里是他们不良人平时练武，切磋的地方。
“大人，统领让我带个新人过来。”
刚来到练武场，宋明远便撇下姜峰，匆匆走上前去。
姜峰看向前方，眼中闪过一丝惊讶之色。
只见武场中央，一位身穿黑色劲装，黛眉星瞳的女子，梳着一个马尾辫，五官秀美精致，眉宇间透着一股英气，手持横刀，在场上的木桩阵内腾闪挪移。
霎时间，密集的刀光如同狂风般呼啸，寒芒闪烁，刀气纵横，顷刻间，数十根木桩同时被拦腰斩断。
气机外放，起码是武道第四境，金刚境的存在！
那女子听到宋明远的呼喊，顿时停下身形，横刀归鞘，眸光清冷的看向这边。
宋明远走到女子不良人跟前，述说着考核情况。
若是以往，这么远的距离姜峰定然是听不到那两人之间的对话。
可自从他觉醒了【六界灵觉】，这种细微的谈话声，也能被他听得一清二楚。
宋明远说：“大人，我看统领的意思，应该是想让他加入我们的队伍。”
黑衣女子皱起眉头：“你也知道，我收人向来严苛，如果随随便便收了人，对你们来说，却是一种不负责任的行为。”
不良人执行任务时大都以团队为主，倘若中间有人拖了后腿，无疑会连累整个团队。
因此，作为一支队伍的领导者，他们收人的时候要考虑到方方面面，否则就是在拿自己和下属的性命当儿戏。

宋明远知道自己这个女领导行事作风，心中暗暗感动。
content_en:
Song Mingyuan smiled: "Actually, the only real assessment of bad people is the first two levels. As for the third level, it is actually the selection of people."
"In the yamen of our bad people's office in Jiangzhou City, there is one commander, five deputy commanders, 22 silver medals, and 206 bronze medals, not counting the chief bookkeeper, the clerk and other civil servants."
"Each deputy commander can control four silver medals, and each silver medal subordinate can control three to five bronze medals. This third level is to see if any silver medal or deputy commander is willing to accept you."
"Of course, the final decision lies with the deputy commander. For example, I can ask for you, but I need to report to my boss. Only after she agrees can I ask for you."
Jiang Feng thought for a while and asked, "Then, what if no one chooses me?"
Song Mingyuan spread his hands: "Then you can only become a Sanren. Sanren generally have two places to go. Those who can read and write can serve as officials of the government.
Those who are good at martial arts are responsible for patrolling and standing guard.
If any team is short of manpower to investigate the case, go to that team to help. "
Jiang Feng suddenly realized that from the moment he passed the literary test, he could be regarded as a bad person.
It's just that it's not yet determined whether it can be incorporated into a combat team.
Song Mingyuan looked at Jiang Feng meaningfully: "You have a letter of introduction, so I don't think that will happen."
Every year there are people who fall into bad relationships through relationships.
This kind of people who come in through the back door, as long as their martial arts level is up to standard, they will basically become bad people.
What, you said there is also a literary test?
Hehe, people who use the back door don’t know the content and answers of the literary test?
In fact, everyone knows this kind of thing.
And most of the people who can come in through the back door have a background and a backer.
Even if they despise each other, they won't show it openly.
In officialdom, in addition to intrigues, there is also the sophistication of people.
Therefore, in Song Mingyuan's view, people like Jiang Feng, who came in through the back door, at least had someone to keep them informed, so that they would not have no one to choose from and become a loose person.
Jiang Feng naturally heard what Song Mingyuan meant, but frowned slightly and didn't say much.
He just asked the teacher to write him a letter of introduction. As for what the letter said, he didn't know.
In fact, the teacher had never supported him becoming a bad person before. In the eyes of scholars, taking the imperial examination promotion path was the right way.
Jiang Feng also talked a lot about this, and finally convinced the teacher to write this letter.
soon.
Song Mingyuan took Jiang Feng to the martial arts training ground in the backyard. This is where the bad guys usually practice martial arts and compete.
"Sir, the commander asked me to bring a new person over."
As soon as he arrived at the martial arts training ground, Song Mingyuan left Jiang Feng and hurriedly walked forward.
Jiang Feng looked forward, a hint of surprise flashing in his eyes.
In the center of the martial arts field, a woman wearing black attire, black eyebrows and starry eyes, combed in a ponytail, with beautiful and delicate facial features, and a heroic spirit between her eyebrows, was holding a horizontal sword and was moving among the wooden piles on the field.
In an instant, the dense sword light roared like a strong wind, the cold light flickered, and the sword energy was crisscrossed. In an instant, dozens of wooden stakes were cut in half at the same time.
The release of Qi is at least the existence of the fourth realm of martial arts, the Vajra realm!
When the woman heard Song Mingyuan's cry, she immediately stopped, sheathed her sword, and looked here with cold eyes.
Song Mingyuan walked up to the female delinquent and described the assessment situation.
If it were in the past, Jiang Feng would definitely not be able to hear the conversation between the two people from such a distance.
But since he awakened [Six Realm Spirit Awareness], he can hear such subtle conversations clearly.
Song Mingyuan said: "Sir, I think the commander's intention is to want him to join our team."
The woman in black frowned: "You also know that I have always been strict in accepting people. If I accept people casually, it would be an irresponsible behavior for you."Bad people mostly work as a team when performing tasks. If someone in the middle is holding back, it will undoubtedly affect the entire team.
Therefore, as leaders of a team, they must consider all aspects when recruiting people, otherwise they will be playing with their own lives and those of their subordinates.
Song Mingyuan knew how she behaved as a female leader, and was secretly moved in her heart.
